name: Haunted Mansion
description: One of the most beloved and perfectly crafted theme park attractions ever created — the Haunted Mansion is a masterpiece of dark ride storytelling featuring 999 happy haunts, extraordinary Audio-Animatronic ghosts, beloved characters including the Hitchhiking Ghosts and a uniquely American vision of supernatural comedy. The single most rerideable attraction at Walt Disney World and one of the greatest theme park experiences in the world. Suitable for all ages.

name: Pirates of the Caribbean
description: The quintessential Disney dark boat ride and one of the most influential theme park attractions ever built — Pirates of the Caribbean transports guests through an extraordinary recreation of a 17th century Caribbean port under attack by pirates, featuring hundreds of elaborate Audio-Animatronic figures, beautiful atmospheric lighting and the legendary theme song. One of the greatest and most beloved Disney classics. Suitable for all ages.

name: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train
description: The most sought-after and beloved new classic at Magic Kingdom — Seven Dwarfs Mine Train is an extraordinary family coaster featuring swinging mine cart vehicles, beautiful storybook theming from Snow White, breathtaking Audio-Animatronic scenes inside the mine and one of the most charming and rerideable ride experiences at Walt Disney World. The most popular attraction at Magic Kingdom. Min 97cm.

name: Space Mountain
description: The most iconic indoor roller coaster at any Disney park in the world — Space Mountain sends riders on a darkened high-speed journey through the cosmos in rockets through a spectacular domed mountain structure. One of the most beloved and enduring Disney attractions since 1975 and a Magic Kingdom institution. Min 112cm.

name: Big Thunder Mountain Railroad
description: The wildest ride in the wilderness — Big Thunder Mountain Railroad is a spectacular mine train coaster racing through the red rock canyons and haunted gold mines of the American Southwest in beautifully detailed themed environments. One of the most beloved and rerideable thrill attractions at Magic Kingdom. Min 112cm.

name: Tiana's Bayou Adventure
description: A spectacular log flume adventure through the magical Louisiana bayou world of The Princess and the Frog — featuring beautiful animatronic characters, atmospheric Southern theming and a thrilling final plunge. One of the most eagerly anticipated new attractions at Magic Kingdom. Min 97cm.

name: Peter Pan's Flight
description: The most magical and enchanting dark ride at Magic Kingdom — Peter Pan's Flight lifts guests into flying pirate ships and soars them over a beautifully miniaturised London at night before whisking them away to Neverland. One of the most iconic, charming and beloved attractions in all of Walt Disney World and a Magic Kingdom original since 1971. Suitable for all ages.

name: Jungle Cruise
description: A beloved and irreplaceable Magic Kingdom classic — Jungle Cruise takes guests on a narrated boat tour through the rivers of Africa, Asia and South America encountering elaborately staged animatronic animals and memorably terrible puns delivered by a live skipper. One of the most beloved and characterful attractions at Walt Disney World. Suitable for all ages.

name: it's a small world
description: The most universally recognised and culturally significant theme park attraction ever created — it's a small world is a gentle boat ride through a celebration of the world's children featuring hundreds of Audio-Animatronic dolls in the national costumes of every country accompanied by the most famous theme park song in history. An unforgettable Magic Kingdom classic. Suitable for all ages.

name: Cinderella Castle
description: The most recognisable and iconic structure in theme park history — Cinderella Castle is the breathtaking centrepiece of Magic Kingdom rising 57 metres above the park with stunning Gothic spires and golden turrets. The defining symbol of Walt Disney World and the most photographed theme park structure in the world. Suitable for all ages.

name: Liberty Square Riverboat
description: A relaxing and atmospheric cruise aboard the magnificent steam-powered Liberty Belle riverboat along the Rivers of America — offering beautiful views of Frontierland and Big Thunder Mountain and a unique slice of American frontier history. The most peaceful and scenic attraction at Magic Kingdom. Suitable for all ages.

name: Tomorrowland
description: The futuristic themed land of Magic Kingdom featuring Space Mountain, Tomorrowland Speedway, Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin, Carousel of Progress and TRON Lightcycle Run — a uniquely atmospheric vision of retro-futurism and one of the most beloved themed lands at any Disney park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Tomorrowland Speedway
description: A beloved Magic Kingdom classic where guests drive gas-powered cars around a guided track — Tomorrowland Speedway is one of the most enduring and popular family attractions at Magic Kingdom loved by young children experiencing their first time behind the wheel. Suitable for all ages.
